---
title: "Risk register"
subtitle: "What could move a deadline, how we would know, and what we do about it"
toc: false
---

```{r}
source(file.path("R", "helpers.R"))
risks <- read_data("risks.csv")
lvl <- c(Low = 1, Medium = 2, High = 3)
risks <- risks |>
  mutate(
    L = lvl[likelihood], I = lvl[impact],
    score = L * I,
    band = case_when(score >= 6 ~ 4, score >= 4 ~ 3, score >= 2 ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(score), id)
```

Ten risks, scored likelihood times impact on a three-point scale. Each one names the trigger that tells us it is happening and the response that is already in the activity list. The register lives in `data/risks.csv`; close a risk by setting its status, and add one when a sync surfaces a new way to lose a deadline.

## The matrix

```{r}
#| results: asis
cell <- function(l, i) {
  ids <- risks |> filter(L == l, I == i) |> pull(id)
  sc <- l * i
  band <- if (sc >= 6) 4 else if (sc >= 4) 3 else if (sc >= 2) 2 else 1
  sprintf('<div class="rm-cell rm-%d"><b>%d</b>%s</div>', band, length(ids),
          if (length(ids)) paste(ids, collapse = ", ") else "")
}
cat('<div class="risk-matrix">')
cat('<div></div><div class="rm-head">Low impact</div><div class="rm-head">Medium impact</div><div class="rm-head">High impact</div>')
for (l in 3:1) {
  cat(sprintf('<div class="rm-side">%s likelihood</div>', names(lvl)[l]))
  for (i in 1:3) cat(cell(l, i))
}
cat('</div>')
```

## The register

```{r}
risks |>
  transmute(
    ID = id,
    Phase = phase_dot(phase),
    Risk = risk,
    Likelihood = likelihood,
    Impact = impact,
    Score = sprintf('<span class="pill %s">%d</span>',
                    c("pill-todo", "pill-near", "pill-near", "pill-critical")[band], score),
    Trigger = trigger,
    Response = response,
    Owner = owner,
    Activities = str_replace_all(activities, ";", ", "),
    Status = pill(status)
  ) |>
  nice_table(align = "lllllclllll") |>
  kableExtra::column_spec(3, width = "22em") |>
  kableExtra::column_spec(7, width = "14em") |>
  kableExtra::column_spec(8, width = "20em")
```
